_README: Per-chain receipt layout quirks, read by scripts/receipt_formats.py.
Keyed by CHAIN, not by branch — a chain's receipts are laid out the same way
in every town. A shop name matches when the chain is a whole-word prefix of it.
Add an entry only for a chain whose receipt has actually been read, and give
every entry a 'source' naming that receipt. A missing entry prints as missing;
a guessed entry gets trusted. Leave a field out when it is not known — the
checklist renders it as '(not recorded)', which is the honest answer.
discounts, deposits, dual_currency, weighed_items. Each may be paired with a
'<field>_note' — note the exact field name, or the note is silently not rendered.

Billa.branch_address_note: The header carries the company's registered address (on the 2026-07-24 Sozopol receipt: СОЗОПОЛ УЛ. ИНДУСТРИАЛНА 3); the actual store address is in the card-terminal footer (УЛ. РЕПУБЛИКАНСКА 5). OSM matches the footer. Take the branch key from the footer.
Billa.multiplier_line_note: The `N x unit_price` line is printed ABOVE the item it belongs to. On 2026-07-24 `3 x 0.71` sits under `BILLA ПОП КЪРПИ 5Б` but belongs to the `ШУМЕНСКО` line below it; the naive top-down reading bills three beers to a pack of cleaning cloths. Both readings look plausible on the photo — only one sums to the printed total.

Coop Extra.branch_address_note: The header names the branch by place only (`Furuset`), with `Butikk 2630-1` as the store number; the legal entity (COOP ØST SA) is a regional co-op, not the store.
Coop Extra.multiplier_line_note: Every line PRICE is printed one line ABOVE its item name: on 2026-09-25 `39.90` stands alone above `BRINGEBÆR 125G`, whose own line shows the next item's `37.40`, and the last price (42.92) sits on `LOLLIPOP 12PK` while `SALATBAR` shows none. Read the price column shifted up by one. A weighed item's `0.232 kg  185.00 kr/kg` line FOLLOWS its name; 0.232 × 185 = 42.92 confirms the shift.
Coop Extra.discounts_note: No discount lines on the one receipt read (`Spart 0.00`). Cash payments add a signed `øreavrunding` line (-0.12) that rounds to whole kroner: the items sum to the unrounded `Sum` (209.12), `Totalt` is the rounded 209.00.
Coop Extra.weighed_items: item name line, then an indented `N kg  P kr/kg` line below it; the price is on the line above the name like every other item
Coop Extra.source: Coop Extra Furuset, 2026-09-25 (read from a photo, IMG_20260925_084043.jpg)

Lidl.multiplier_line_note: Never transcribed from a photo — Lidl trips are imported from the lidl_receipts.json export, which carries one object per line item with explicit quantity, so there is no multiplier line to misread. The printed receipt's layout is genuinely unrecorded; read it before adding one here.

discounts.representation: per-line `discounts` array in the JSON export, not separate printed lines
discounts.sign: positive saving amounts; the line's `line_total` is GROSS and `net_total` is what was charged
discounts.kinds: lidlplus_coupon (Open Prices LOYALTY_PROGRAM), markdown (EXPIRES_SOON); a line can carry several at once

Lidl.discounts_note: The 2026-07-21 кисело краве мляко line carried both a Lidl Plus coupon and a separate 20% short-expiry markdown. Reading `total_price_no_saving` as the trip total overstates it — that trip's gross was 54.43 against a 51.77 net charge.
Lidl.weighed_items: receipt name ends in `НА КГ`; quantity is kilograms and `price` is per-kg
